content.title: Tamil Nadu Sees Fewer Cyclones Crossing Its Coast During Northeast Monsoon
content.caption: Tamil Nadu has experienced relatively fewer cyclonic systems crossing its coast during the Northeast monsoon in the past 45 years.

slides.heading: Tamil Nadu Sees Fewer Cyclones Crossing Its Coast During Northeast
slides.text: Tamil Nadu has experienced relatively fewer cyclonic systems crossing its coast during the Northeast monsoon in the past 45 years.

slides.heading: Weather Trends
slides.text: The Bay of Bengal is churning its next cyclone for the season, but the current predictions indicate the possibility of less rainfall over Tamil Nadu.

slides.heading: Past Weather Trends
slides.text: Senior meteorologists point out that only 22 of the 117 cyclonic systems that formed over the Bay of Bengal during October and November, between 1981 and 2025, made landfall along the State’s coast.
